acceptanceCriteria: the registration steps for a new shell test and a new GATE_STEPS entry are documented in one place and linked from docs/AGENT-ROUTES.md or the owning spec
a check or test message points to that note when either registration is missing
body:
Reported by the lane-ops lane on 2026-10-21 (V1-0360, V1-1978, V1-1725 shell tooling). Adding new script/*_test.sh files required registering them with the unbounded-readers check and keeping the session-test-runner STR-V0-004 gate-step list aligned with Makefile GATE_STEPS. Neither rule is written down, so the lane found both by failing gates.
Expected: a short contract note in the relevant spec or docs/ route that says where a new shell test and a new gate step must be registered.

title: Document how shell-script tests register with the unbounded-readers ratchet and how STR-V0-004 couples to Makefile GATE_STEPS
